_about: The judge's scripted brain (plan P7: 'the scripted brain and recorded fixtures'; p7-design-gate D8). Each entry answers any prompt containing `when`, first match in order, so a more specific entry comes before one whose text it contains. Handles (p1, m1, i1, k1, u1) are the ones the intent prompt gives the context package's items; Core validates every one. Nothing here is Core logic: a recording is what a model would have said. The `planner` list (P8) answers plan.v1: an entry with `when` answers the mission whose prompt contains it, and the entry without one answers every other mission with a one-task plan. Task ids are the model's own labels (Core keys the tasks t1..tN), r1/c1 the mission's requirement and constraint handles; Core validates every plan.
